## Brief

Target: clicking it opens the same three-item menu the screening room shows (web/index.html #export-menu: Audio / Video / Vertical reel, same icons, labels and menu styling), and each item produces exactly what the screening room's item produces for that take (exportWav, exportVideo, exportReel in web/booth.js; wiring in web/app.js). Keep the button desktop-only as it is now unless the screening room's equivalent differs.

Setup: `bash scripts/worktree-init.sh` first in this worktree. Read CLAUDE.md, web/CLAUDE.md and .claude/skills/implementing-changes/SKILL.md; the skill's tier table decides what proves the change. Keep new modules under the 250-line look-again point (web/app-takes.js is 122 lines).
Verify: `npm test`, plus drive the web app (`npm run web`, http://localhost:8901) in a real browser: open a scene with a saved take, click the row button, screenshot the open menu, and confirm Audio, Video and Vertical reel each start the same export as from the screening room (file/job produced, no console errors).
